chunks: All those there are in the heavens and the earth turn to Him with solicitation, intent on His purpose all the time.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is in a constant state of affairs and all beings ask Him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Dawr al-Sha'n* (the cycle of divine affairs), illustrating that God is never static but constantly engaged in new acts of creation and governance. It reflects the dynamic nature of the Divine, where every moment brings a fresh manifestation of His will, distinguishing His eternal activity from the passive existence of created beings.
